pegasustr.text: PegasusTR plays a fast, front-foot game: upper tier across the matchups, a quick trigger, and unshaken when the opposition stiffens. The edge softens a little when the opposition gets toughest, the one wrinkle in an otherwise strong card. An older, smaller opponent sample stands behind this one, so treat it as a sketch rather than a portrait.

pinkoctapus.text: PINKOCTAPUS has been at this since 2012, and the years show: matchup rating among the very best, resistance to match, and a lifetime kill-death line near the top. The headshot share is thin and the lifetime IvI sits below the middle, so the lifetime board sells the whole picture short. A veteran who still fights at the very top of the tracked population.

plasmatr.text: PlasmaTR is a veteran of the long game: fighting since 2018 with a matchup rating near the top, activity keeping pace, and bravery up at the top. The accuracy sits at the very top, and so does the headshot share, and the lifetime board agrees with the matchups. Take this as a sketch, not a portrait: the opponent sample behind it runs older and smaller.

pikaqiuill.text: PIkaqiuIll plays a patient, precise game: sits near the best tracked across the matchup board, sharp of aim, and ironclad as the opposition strengthens. The output fades as the opposition strengthens. Waiting for the right moment is the game, not chasing every fight. Headshots are rare, and the form gives ground versus the strongest third. Still early, but the first pages already speak volumes.

pragenc.text: PrageNC plays by the book and it shows: top shelf across the board, with a trigger that runs hot and an appetite that grows as the foes get fiercer. The kept share stays firm against the strongest third too. Take this one as a sketch — the opponent sample behind it is older and smaller — but the shape of it is all confidence.

preciouspebblenc.text: PreciousPebbleNc brings the pace: the trigger runs at the fastest clip on the board, and the game rises as the pressure rises. Aim still holds, headshots stacking up, and the all-time numbers agree with the matchups. Top shelf throughout — a strong regular, full stop.

pegasusnc.text: PegasusNC lets the aim do the talking: in the top ranks, with accuracy and headshots among the very best in the data. The consistency line holds strong against the strongest third, and never bends against harder foes. The lifetime sheet agrees with the matchups, a sharp, steady card by any measure.

puritync.text: PurityNC plays a fast, fearless game built on pace: kills coming quicker than almost anyone tracked, with a work rate at the very top. The rating sits top-shelf, and the game thrives as the enemies get tougher. Pace is the story here, and the lifetime IvI sits among the best, so the lifetime board rates them even higher than the matchups do.

pragens.text: PrageNS runs on pure pace: a top-shelf matchup game built on pace ranked with the very best, and Brave to match. The accuracy sits near the top and the headshots follow. The lifetime kill-death line sits just above average, the one soft spot on an otherwise gleaming card.

plasmanc.text: PlasmaNC has been at this since 2014, and still plays with bite: sitting top shelf, with bravery at the very top. The output keeps climbing as the foes get stronger, and the pace runs near the very top. A veteran career, still played with fire. The aim stays near the top too.

preciouspebbletr.text: PreciousPebbleTr plays at a sprint: kill pace near the very top, bravery to match, and activity that never lets up. The matchup kill-death mark lands merely above average — volume over efficiency — while the accuracy and headshot share both sit near the top. The lifetime board puts them among the very best, and the consistency holds mid-pack. A whirlwind with a sharp edge.

poggausseu.text: POGgaussEU is barely two weeks old and already tearing up the card: tempo near the very top, bravery among the very best tracked, and a matchup mark in step. Kills come at a furious pace, the aim stays precise, and headshots make up a strong share too. Early read, but the opening pages already hint at something special.

pragetr.text: PrageTR plays a complete, high-volume game: tempo near the very top, with bravery right there with it, and resistance to match. Aim is precise, headshots land often, and the matchup mark lands well above average. The lifetime numbers place them among the best tracked, while consistency holds above average — a card with no soft spot.

playerfabi.text: playerfabi plays a fast, fearless game: rating, activity, bravery, resistance — all up near the very top. Pace is relentless, the aim sits above average, and headshots claim a solid share of the attempts. The matchup kill-death mark trails a notch behind the rest, the lifetime board trails the matchups by a notch, and the edge softens slightly against the strongest third.

plasma.text: Plasma has carried a top-shelf game since 2013: matchup rating, activity, bravery, and resistance all in the top ranks, with pace and precision to match. Sharp aim, plenty of headshots, and the lifetime ledger lines up with the matchups. The opponent sample behind this one is older and smaller, so take it as an outline rather than a finished portrait.

prepubliccwarmachinenc.text: PRepublicCWarMachineNC wins with patience and precision: matchup rating and bravery in the top ranks, resistance right there, and a headshot share among the best tracked. The pace sits above the pack rather than at the very front, and the aim runs above average. The lifetime record echoes the matchups, and the strongest third leaves the game mid-pack.

prageeutr.text: PrageEUTR is barely a week into the record and already charging: bravery and kill pace both sitting at the peak, the game gaining ground as the enemies get stronger. Activity runs near the top, the aim is precise, with a headshot share that ranks near the top. Consistency holds above average, so the edge survives the strongest third intact. Early read, but the first pages already carry thunder.

preciouspebble.text: PreciousPebble plays at full tilt: pace and aim both at the top, with a headshot share near the summit and bravery rising with the caliber of the enemy. The matchup kill-death mark lands above average, a notch below the rest of the card. Consistency sits below average, so the strongest third softens the edge. A fast, fearless fighter whose sharpest gear still has another level to find.

pikachonk.text: Pikachonk is pure voltage: a kill pace at the very top, bravery that rises as the opposition improves, and accuracy near the very top. The headshot share runs high, so the volume carries precision. Consistency lands mid-pack, the only soft edge on an otherwise electric card.

procjsounctakhranaty.text: procjsounctakhranaty is all momentum: a top-shelf rating, a brisk output, and a game that stays sharp as the opposition improves. Accuracy sits near the very top, with a strong headshot share backing every push. The lifetime IvI sits above average too, a notch behind the matchups.

priincessa.text: Priincessa plays with poise and bite: the rating, the tempo, the bravery, the resistance — all settle in the upper tier; the matchup kill-death mark follows close behind. Consistency runs above average, so the edge survives the toughest third, and the pace stays brisk without ever looking rushed. The lifetime ledger tells the same story, rating the same all-around strength.

priincessanc.text: PriincessaNC brings pressure from every angle: the adjusted rating, the tempo, and the game against stronger enemies all land near the top, with kills arriving fast and the kill-death figure up there too. Accuracy and headshots clear well above average; lifetime figures tell the same story. A complete, high-volume presence that never seems to ease off.

priincessavs.text: PriincessaVS turns every fight into a footrace they win: kills arrive fast, the tempo sits near the top, and the game climbs as the enemies get tougher. The kill-death mark sits near the top too, headshots land well above average, and accuracy holds the middle ground. The lifetime board sits in the same high range, so the whole card reads strong.

probicaltr.text: ProbicalTR plays like a flood: kill pace up near the very top, a game that gathers force as the opposition improves; accuracy sits near the top. The matchup score rests near the top; lifetime board tells the same tale. Consistency dips below average, the one soft line on a card that otherwise runs hot.
